en.title: PegCanvas — Turn any picture into a pegboard wall
en.description: PegCanvas turns illustrations, photos and logos into modular multi-color pegboards right in your browser, and exports a 3MF ready for your 3D printer.
en.heroBadge: Free to try now. Paid plans opening soon.
en.heroH1: Turn any picture into a wall you use.
en.heroCopy: Upload an illustration, photo or logo. PegCanvas turns it into modular, multi-color pegboards right in your browser and exports a 3MF ready for your 3D printer.
en.check2: Your images stay in your browser
en.splitOpen: Take it apart: one image, four panels
en.inspTitle:
A storage wall
that doubles as art.
en.s0Body: A botanical design flows across several panels, with room for keys, hats and small plants.
en.s0Alt: AI concept: entryway wall with a botanical design spanning several pegboards
en.s1Body: Warm geometric shapes become a full wall piece. It looks like art and still works as a pegboard.
en.s1Alt: AI concept: warm geometric pegboard wall art above a living-room sofa
en.s2Body: A full fantasy mural behind your setup. Hang the headset, controller and figures right on it and keep the desk clear.
en.s2Alt: AI concept: fantasy-illustration pegboard wall above a gaming desk, holding a headset and controller
en.s3Body: A race track becomes the wall itself, with toys and tracks hanging right beside it.
en.s3Alt: AI concept: race-track themed pegboard wall in a kids room
en.sloganH2:
Why choose plain
when you can make it fun?
en.howTitle: Three steps from picture to wall.
en.h0Body: PNG, JPEG or SVG. Compare 4 to 16-color versions and confirm before it goes on the canvas.
en.h1Body: Set the panel size and add panels in any direction. Scale and rotate layers, and color each panel your way.
en.h2Body: One multi-material 3MF with a plate per panel. Open it in your slicer and print.
en.colorNote: The strip shows the filament colors used at this color count. Nothing goes on the canvas until you confirm, and your original is kept.
en.sizeNote: From 120 to 240 mm to fit your printer. Add panels in any direction to build a full wall.
en.exportNote: One plate per panel. Open it in your slicer and print.
en.specTitle:
You bring the idea.
We handle sizes and holes.
en.sp1Body: Adjust the design depth; the base fills the rest.
en.sp2Body: One global hole grid, aligned across every panel.
en.sp3Body: Adjustable or off. Screws sit flush on the wall.
en.sp4Body: Scale, rotate and stack layers, with colors per panel.
en.pricingTitle:
Every feature included.
Pay for commercial rights.
en.pricingCopy: All paid plans have the same design features. One-time purchase, no subscription, and every future update to the web app is included.
en.freeList:
• Up to 2 panels per project
  • Up to 3 image layers
  • Up to 4 colors
  • Unlimited 3MF exports
  • Non-commercial use only
en.personalList:
• Unlimited panels, layers and colors
  • Cross-panel designs and large walls
  • One-time purchase, free updates
  • Personal, non-commercial use
en.commercialList:
• Everything in Personal
  • Sell pegboards you print
  • Design and print custom orders
  • Does not include selling digital files
en.studioList:
• Everything in Commercial
  • Sell and deliver 3MF/STL files
  • Run a custom digital model service
  • 3 seats
en.licenseNote: Licenses cover your use of PegCanvas output. You are responsible for rights to any images, characters or brand assets you use.
en.q1: Do I need to install anything or sign up?
en.a1: No install. Design, preview and download in your browser; images are processed locally and never uploaded. The current preview needs no login. The full release uses one-click Google sign-in, with no separate account to create.
en.a2: An FDM printer that supports multi-material printing, and a slicer that opens 3MF files. Match colors to the filament you already have.
en.a3: Each panel can be 40–240 mm in 20 mm steps; 120, 160, 200 and 240 mm keep the hole pattern identical on every panel. Tile panels in any direction to cover a whole wall.
en.q4: Will I have to pay again later?
en.a4: No. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription, and every future update to the web app is included, so you always have the latest version. If we ever shut down the online service, we will provide an offline version so you can keep using it.
en.ctaCopy: Email us to be first in line when we launch, and don’t miss early-bird pricing.

en.legalDescription: What PegCanvas collects, where your images are processed, and who owns what.
en.privacyBody:
PegCanvas is owned and operated by Babyglider Online Store, a company registered in the Philippines. Questions or requests about this notice go to hello@pegcanvas.com.

Your images and designs

The editor at app.pegcanvas.com runs in your browser. The images you add, your designs and the print files you generate are processed on your own device and are not uploaded to us. Work in progress is kept in your browser's storage on that device so you can pick it up again; clearing your browser data removes it. Project files and print files are saved only where you choose to download them.

What we receive

  • Email you send us. If you write to us, for example to be told when paid plans open, we keep your email address and message to reply and to send that notice. Ask at any time and we will delete them.
  • Technical logs. Our pages are delivered by Cloudflare, which handles your IP address, browser type and the pages requested in order to serve the site and protect it from abuse.
  • Visit statistics. pegcanvas.com uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits and see which pages are read. It works without cookies and does not identify individual visitors.
  • Fonts. pegcanvas.com loads its display typeface from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google's servers when you open the site.
  • Language choice. Your language preference is stored in your browser, not on our servers.

We do not run advertising, we do not track you across sites, we do not use tracking cookies, and we do not sell personal information.

Signing in with Google

The editor works without an account. Signing in with Google is optional and unlocks more features. Nothing is sent to Google until you open the sign-in window.

  • What we read. Your name, email address and profile picture, from the sign-in Google returns to your browser. They are kept in that browser only, to show that you are signed in. We do not store them on a server, and signing out removes them.
  • Google Drive. If you choose to save a project to Google Drive, the editor asks for permission to see and manage only the files it creates there. It cannot see anything else in your Drive. Project files go straight from your browser to your own Drive; they do not pass through us, and you can delete them or withdraw the permission in your Google Account at any time.

Your choices

You can ask us what we hold about you, or to correct or delete it, by writing to the address above. If this notice changes, the new version is posted here with a new date.
en.copyrightBody:

Who owns PegCanvas

PegCanvas is owned and operated by Babyglider Online Store, a company registered in the Philippines. Where this page says "we", "us" or "ours", it means Babyglider Online Store. You can reach us at hello@pegcanvas.com.

What is ours

The PegCanvas software, this website, its text and design, and the PegCanvas name and logo belong to us. PegCanvas™ is used as our brand. You may not copy or redistribute the software or the site's content, or use the name or logo in a way that suggests we made or endorse something we did not, without written permission.

What is yours

You keep every right you have in the images you bring to PegCanvas and in the designs you make with it. We claim no ownership of them and never receive them. You are responsible for having the right to use any image, character, logo or brand you turn into a panel. How you may use the print files PegCanvas generates, including commercially, depends on the plan described on the pricing section of this site.

Illustrations on this site

Room scenes marked as AI concepts are illustrations, not photographs of printed products, and do not show supported accessories or shipped features.

Other names

Names of printers, slicers and other products mentioned in PegCanvas belong to their owners and appear only to describe compatibility. PegCanvas is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by them.

Open-source software

The editor includes open-source components under their own licences, listed in the third-party notices.

Printed panels

PegCanvas produces files for you to print. Printed panels and hooks are for light loads only: do not hang fragile or valuable items, or anything that would be dangerous if it fell. Print quality, mounting and load are your responsibility, and the software is provided as is.

Reporting a concern

If you believe something on this site infringes your rights, write to hello@pegcanvas.com with the details and we will look into it.

zh.privacyBody:
PegCanvas 由在菲律賓註冊的公司 Babyglider Online Store 所有並營運。對本聲明有任何問題或請求，請來信 hello@pegcanvas.com。

你的圖片與設計

app.pegcanvas.com 的編輯器在你的瀏覽器裡執行。你加入的圖片、你的設計，以及生成的列印檔，都在你自己的裝置上處理，不會上傳給我們。進行中的作品會保存在該裝置的瀏覽器儲存空間，方便你下次繼續；清除瀏覽器資料就會移除。作品檔與列印檔只會存到你選擇下載的位置。

我們會收到的資料

  • 你寄給我們的信。如果你來信，例如登記開賣通知，我們會保留你的電子郵件地址與信件內容，用來回覆和寄送該通知。你隨時可以要求我們刪除。
  • 技術紀錄。網站由 Cloudflare 提供服務，為了傳送網頁與防止濫用，Cloudflare 會處理你的 IP 位址、瀏覽器類型與請求的頁面。
  • 造訪統計。pegcanvas.com 使用 Cloudflare Web Analytics 統計造訪次數與被閱讀的頁面。它不使用 Cookie，也不辨識個別訪客。
  • 字型。pegcanvas.com 的標題字型從 Google Fonts 載入，所以開啟網站時你的瀏覽器會連到 Google 的伺服器。
  • 語言選擇。你選擇的語言存在你的瀏覽器裡，不在我們的伺服器上。

我們不投放廣告、不跨網站追蹤你、不使用追蹤用 Cookie，也不販售個人資料。

使用 Google 登入

編輯器不登入也能使用。Google 登入是選用的，登入後可使用更多功能。在你打開登入視窗之前，不會有任何資料送到 Google。

  • 我們讀取的資料。Google 回傳給你瀏覽器的名稱、電子郵件地址與大頭貼。這些只保存在該瀏覽器，用來顯示你已登入；我們不會把它們存到伺服器，登出就會移除。
  • Google 雲端硬碟。如果你選擇把作品存到 Google 雲端硬碟，編輯器會請求只能查看與管理「它自己建立的檔案」的權限，看不到你雲端硬碟裡的其他內容。作品檔從你的瀏覽器直接存到你自己的雲端硬碟，不經過我們；你隨時可以刪除檔案，或在 Google 帳戶中撤銷這項權限。

你的選擇

你可以來信詢問我們保有哪些關於你的資料，或要求更正、刪除。本聲明若有變更，新版本會公布在這裡並更新日期。
